findings.message: <section id="title-card"> is a timeline element that contains nested <h1 id="title-name">. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <section id="title-card"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
